cards.text: The LORD speaks to Moses, with a message for Aaron the priest. It's all about the seven lamps on the lampstand.

cards.question: When Aaron sets up the seven lamps, where are they supposed to throw their light?

answers.text: Onto the area in front of the lampstand
Up toward the ceiling of the tent
Back toward the curtain behind it

cards.question: Aaron sets up the lamps his own way, a little different from what the LORD commanded.

cards.text: Quick word about the lampstand itself. It's hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, and friend, I stand on a gold BASE and that thing STILL makes me feel underdressed.

cards.question: The golden lampstand was fashioned according to the pattern the LORD had shown ___.

cards.text: Lamps are lit. Now the LORD speaks to Moses again, and this time it's about the Levites, one of Israel's tribes.

cards.question: Before anything else, what does the LORD tell Moses to do with the Levites?

answers.text: Move them to the camp's edge

cards.text: Here's how the LORD says to cleanse them. First, Moses is to sprinkle the Levites with the water of purification.

cards.question: After the sprinkling, what does the LORD say the Levites are to do to purify themselves?

answers.text: Shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes
Fast seven days and stay inside their tents
Bathe at the river and burn their old robes

cards.text: Their WHOLE bodies, friend, so one shave and I'd lose my mustache AND my hands. Next, the Levites are to take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil.

cards.question: Moses is to take a second young bull, this one for a sin offering.

cards.text: Then Moses is to bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. And he's to assemble the whole congregation of Israel.

cards.question: With all Israel assembled at the Tent of Meeting, the LORD says the Israelites are to lay their hands on the Levites.

cards.text: Then Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel. A whole tribe, presented before the LORD, and the last time anybody presented ME, I was sitting in a bargain bin with a 25 cent sticker on my head.

cards.question: Why is Aaron to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering?

answers.text: So they can do the LORD's service
So they can lead Israel's army
So they can judge the other tribes

cards.text: Next, the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the two bulls. One is to be offered to the LORD as a sin offering, and the other as a burnt offering.

cards.question: The LORD says the two bulls are to be offered to make ___ for the Levites.

cards.text: Then the Levites are to stand before Aaron and his sons. After that, they're to be presented before the LORD as a wave offering.

cards.question: The LORD says all this will separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will ___ to Him.
The LORD says that even after being cleansed and presented, the Levites must wait a full year before they serve at the Tent of Meeting.

cards.text: Now the LORD tells Moses why the Levites are getting all this. They have been wholly given to Him from among the sons of Israel.

cards.question: The LORD says He has taken the Levites for Himself in place of all the ___ of Israel.

cards.text: Here's the background. Every firstborn male in Israel belongs to the LORD, both man and beast.

cards.question: When did the LORD set Israel's firstborn apart for Himself?

answers.text: The day He struck Egypt's firstborn
The day He parted the Red Sea
The day He gave the Ten Commandments

cards.text: So the Levites stand in for all the firstborn among the sons of Israel. That's one tribe picking up EVERY firstborn's shift, baker, and most people cover ONE shift and talk about it for a month.

cards.question: The LORD gives the Levites to Aaron and his sons as a gift.
The Levites serve for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and make atonement for them, so that no ___ will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.

cards.text: Then Moses, Aaron and the whole congregation do everything the LORD commanded with the Levites. EVERYTHING, friend, and I've had batches where I couldn't follow my OWN recipe card.
The Levites purify themselves and wash their clothes. Aaron presents them as a wave offering before the LORD and makes atonement to cleanse them.

cards.question: Once they're dedicated, the Levites start their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Moses and the elders.

cards.text: Then the LORD has one more word for Moses about the Levites. This one's about age.

cards.question: At what age can a Levite man start the work at the Tent of Meeting?
Once a Levite starts the work at the Tent of Meeting, he keeps doing it for the rest of his life.
At fifty, a Levite stops doing the work. What can he still do at the Tent of Meeting?

answers.text: Help his brothers with their duties
Train the new priests in the law

cards.text: And that's how the LORD tells Moses to assign the Levites their responsibilities. A plan for the later years, baker, and MY retirement plan was the back of a junk drawer.

findings.problem: The opening card names Moses without saying who he is, although Aaron receives a simple introduction. Moses needs a brief identification, such as Moses, Israel's leader.

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards points to the firstborn rather than the elders or priests. The preceding story card says only that the Levites were wholly given to the LORD, so the baker can only guess this unseen word.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: No earlier card connects the Levites' service and atonement with protection from a plague. The setup gives the baker no basis for choosing plague over army or drought, making this blank a guess at wording not yet seen.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: Thirty is a defensible answer as worded. Numbers 8:24 permits men twenty-five years of age or older to enter the service, so a thirty-year-old can start the work. Asking for the minimum starting age would make Twenty-five uniquely correct.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.
